text: Serves AI models from many providers through one provider-agnostic API
quote: The core of AI Gateway is the ability to serve AI Models from various AI Model Providers via a provider-agnostic API.

text: Quickstart script spins up a demo AI Gateway instance almost instantly
quote: You can use the quickstart script to get a demo instance of AI Gateway running almost instantly.

text: Logs and analytics capture request/response payloads, token usage, model details, latency, and cost
quote: AI Gateway logs capture detailed information about the request and response payloads, token usage, model details, latency, and cost metrics.

text: Calculates exact per-request LLM cost matching what the provider actually bills
quote: AI Gateway calculates that figure for every request to a large language model (LLM) provider, matching what the provider actually bills.

text: Supports Azure Managed Identity / User-Assigned Identity for provider authentication when running on Azure
quote: Yes, if AI Gateway is running on Azure, you can configure an AI Model Provider to detect the designated Managed Identity or User-Assigned Identity of that Azure Compute resource and use it for authentication.

text: Proxies traffic from AI command-line tools to LLM providers, centralizing logging, cost tracking, and rate limiting
quote: AI Gateway can proxy requests from AI command-line tools to LLM providers. This gives you centralized control over AI traffic: log all requests, track costs across teams, enforce rate limits

text: Acts as a control and observability layer for agent-to-agent (A2A) traffic, routing requests and rewriting agent card URLs
quote: AI Gateway acts as a control and observability layer for A2A traffic, enabling you to route agent-to-agent requests, extract task metadata, and rewrite agent card URLs so clients route through the Gateway.

text: AI Auth Strategy can authenticate A2A clients on AI Agent entities, with size-limiting policies for agent traffic
quote: Reference an AI Auth Strategy on your AI Agent entities to authenticate A2A clients, and attach the Request Size Limiting Policy to limit request size before traffic reaches your agents.

text: Provides content safety features and Prompt Guards on chat/completion requests across providers
quote: AI Gateway supports content safety features across providers and also includes our Prompt Guards that act on any llm/v1/chat or llm/v1/completions requests.

text: Performs semantic caching, routing, and content filtering using semantic similarity queries
quote: AI Gateway can perform intelligent request routing, caching, and content filtering using semantic similarity queries.

text: Provides an advanced rate-limiting plugin specifically for AI/LLM traffic
quote: AI Rate Limiting Advanced - Plugin | Kong Docs

text: AI MCP Server entity turns any REST API into an MCP server/tool without requiring an LLM
quote: Turn any API into an MCP server using the AI MCP Server entity. This approach does not require an LLM and provides full control over production workloads.

text: AI MCP Proxy can front and expose existing upstream MCP servers through the gateway
quote: AI MCP Proxy bridges Kong-managed Services to the Model Context Protocol, converting REST APIs into MCP tools or fronting upstream MCP servers.

text: Admin API endpoint to list all AI Gateways in an organization
quote: list-ai-gateways summary: List AI Gateways description: Returns a list of AI Gateways in the organization.

text: Single gateway can govern LLM, MCP, and A2A traffic together
quote: Govern LLM, MCP, and agent-to-agent (A2A) traffic with the same Kong AI Gateway.

text: Streams LLM responses token-by-token back to clients in real time
quote: most models can stream each word (or sets of words and tokens) back to the client. This allows the chat response to be rendered in real time.

text: Load balances requests across multiple LLM models
quote: AI Gateway provides load balancing capabilities to distribute requests across multiple LLM models.

text: AI Vault entity lets providers, auth strategies, agents, and MCP servers reference secrets from external backends like AWS Secrets Manager or HashiCorp Vault
quote: An AI Vault entity lets you register an external secret backend (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, environment variables, or others) so that AI Model Providers, AI Auth Strategies, AI Models, AI Agents, and AI MCP Servers can reference

text: Authenticates enterprise users via existing identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Google, OIDC) without manual key management
quote: Authenticate enterprise users through an existing identity provider (Okta, Azure AD, Google, or any OIDC-compliant IdP) without managing keys manually

text: kongctl CLI includes an AI Gateway conversion extension to migrate existing configurations
quote: walks you through migrating an existing configuration using the kongctl AI Gateway conversion extension

text: Exports OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP, and A2A traffic
quote: AI Gateway can export OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP, and A2A traffic through an OpenTelemetry AI Policy.

text: Same AI capabilities can be configured via plugins attached to Services and Routes
quote: This page shows you how to configure the same capabilities with AI plugins on Services and Routes.

text: Supports AWS Guardrails to validate requests and responses before forwarding to/from upstream LLMs
quote: Use AWS Guardrails to validate requests and/or responses before forwarding them between clients and upstream LLMs.

text: Applies safety and DLP policies to block toxic content and strip personally identifiable information
quote: Apply safety and DLP policies to prevent toxic content and remove personally identifiable information.
